Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

away adverb

not here, absent

also absent, be away, out, not at home, be absent, absentee

classical

Gell. 15.7.3: cum ā mē abes
Cic. Fam. 2.7.1: longē absum, audiō sērō (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 28: absēns, absentis, absent; also an absentee

absum, abesse, āfuī

verb, irregular (like sum)

be away, be absent; be … away (of distance)

The opposite of adsum. Of distance too: Quantum abest?, how far is it? (see how far).

Other words

  • forīs — out, not at home

    adverb · also used · classical · Plaut. Capt. 1.2.5: sī forīs, sī intus volent (Lewis & Short); Cic. Fam. 9.24.3: forīs cēnitandō

    The opposite of domī and intus; going out is forās. Away abroad is peregrē (see abroad).

Examples

  • avē, mī Gāī, meus asellus jūcundissimus, quem semper medius fidius dēsīderō, cum ā mē abes

    hello, my Gaius, my dearest little donkey, whom I always miss, I swear, when you’re away from meGell. 15.7.3

See also away, abroad, how far is it?, far, absence.
